title: CARRIED OVER (live-API-gated, NOT resolvable without a token): queryStatus (bank-payout-watcher.mjs:152-164) is still an EXPLICITLY UNVERIFIED GMO bulktransfer/status endpoint/shape, and it is batch-granular — one batch-level status string is applied to every submitted row sharing that ref (pollCompletions, line 111-121). getBalance (line 197-219) shares the same unverified-endpoint caveat for 残高照会.
description: This is the honest convergence ceiling, restated unchanged from round-5. queryStatus parses j.status/j.transferStatus into a single completed/failed/pending verdict by substring match and applies it to every row carrying that ref; GMO 一括振込 status is per-item, but there is no per-item read. Consequences remain: a batch-level success substring marks ALL rows of the batch status='paid' even if an individual item did not settle (the row leaves 'submitted' so the poll never revisits it — a reconciliation blind spot), and a batch-level failure substring mass-routes a settled batch to needs_review. Crucially, since FIND-105 now makes a needs_review row re-dispatchable on operator re-queue, a FALSE 'failed' classification here is no longer merely operator noise: it can feed the FIND-105 double-pay lever. The endpoint path and response field names cannot be verified without a real GMO_AOZORA_ACCESS_TOKEN (sunabar sandbox or 法人 account); the code marks this UNVERIFIED at lines 152 and 202. The per-item granularity defect is itself a code change that COULD be made now (read itemId->status) but cannot be VERIFIED correct until the token exists, so it is correctly classified as verification-gated.

recommendation: On first live GMO token: confirm bulktransfer/status + accounts/{id}/balances endpoint+shape and read PER-ITEM status (itemId->status) so 'paid' is set only for items GMO confirms settled. Add a test that a batch ref shared by 2 submitted rows is not blanket-marked on an ambiguous status. This finding cannot be CLOSED without a real token and is the documented convergence ceiling.
